in_marathi.name: Ahladini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahladini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahladini is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ahlada' which means joy, happiness, or bliss. This name is given to a baby girl to signify the arrival of immense joy and happiness in the family.
